analysis.visual_description: On the board. One sheet in the early light. The first line is written. Under it a blank the width of a speech, marked only with a count. No second sheet.
On the board. The same sheet, lower down, two lines only, after the blank.
On the board. Under the turn the page is empty. His right hand is at the edge, ink on the finger. No candle. The house is not up.
